subject: ISV integration accelerator: LangChain/LlamaIndex adapter + tracing
messages:
From: Jordan Halpern <jordan@promptworks.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: PromptWorks Partnerships <partners@promptworks.ai>, Eve Tran <eve.tran@toolsmith.io>
Date: Tue, 02 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Partnership proposal — LangChain + LlamaIndex adapter + tracing hooks

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the call last week. PromptWorks has built a thin SDK that a number of ISVs use to standardize the LangChain and LlamaIndex integrations in their toolchain. We think Redwood's runtime (esp. the tracing/observability model) is a great match and would like to run a focused integration pilot that demonstrates: 1) a LangChain/LlamaIndex adapter that uses Redwood's streaming API and 2) a tracing hook that surfaces token-level latency + span correlations in our telemetry.

Attached is a short MVP scope (MVP-scope-LC-LI-adapter.xlsx) and a proposed mutual action plan (mutual-action-plan.pdf). High level asks:
- 4-week pilot with a single ISV reference app (we can provide test prompts)
- Access to a Redwood sandbox API key and a short-lived tracing token for integration testing
- A 60-minute kickoff this week to align owners and milestones

We can be flexible on dates — available Wed/Thu afternoons PT. Tell me whom to invite from your side and we'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Jordan Halpern
Head of Integrations, PromptWorks
jordan@promptworks.ai

PS — quick links inside the attachments with the MAM and a Drive folder for shared artifacts.
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Halpern <jordan@promptworks.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Partnership proposal — LangChain + LlamaIndex adapter + tracing hooks

Jordan — thanks for the materials and the clear ask. Appreciate the concise scope.

Quick answers up front: we can spin up a sandbox key + tracing token for the pilot (security review permitting) and a 4-week pilot sounds reasonable. Suggested attendees for the kickoff: me (PM, integrations), Marissa (ISV partnerships lead), Vanessa (SDK/interop PM), and Karthik (runtime/telemetry).

A few clarifying questions before the kickoff so we can prep:
- Can you confirm which LangChain connectors (LLM wrappers) you expect us to exercise and whether the LlamaIndex use is read-only retrieval or includes document ingestion?
- The tracing hook — do you need token-level spans for every call or sampled traces during high-latency scenarios?
- Any compliance constraints for the sandbox data (PII/no-PII)?

Proposed kickoff windows: Wed 02/03 2:00–4:00 PM PT or Thu 02/04 10:00–11:30 AM PT. I'll hold the slots tentatively if either works.

On attachments: I pulled the MAM into our shared Drive (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDEFgHIJKlmno) and added a short internal checklist for entitlements.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Product Manager, Integrations
Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Halpern <jordan@promptworks.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Feb 2027 12:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Partnership proposal — LangChain + LlamaIndex adapter + tracing hooks

Thanks Jordan — excited to move this forward. Two quick notes from partnership and product:

1) Scope split: let's treat the work as two parallel tracks in the MAM — Adapter (LangChain + LlamaIndex wiring, SDK samples, docs) and Observability (tracing hook, sample dashboards, SLO checklist). That will let us onboard an ISV while delivering measurable telemetry value.

2) Security/compliance — Mateo, please ask PromptWorks to fill the short security questionnaire (I attached our one-page sandbox entitlements form to the Drive). For the pilot we usually enable scoped keys locked to non-prod endpoints and 30-day TTL tokens.

Jordan — can you and Eve fill the ‘sandbox entitlements’ tab in the MAM and confirm the LangChain connector list? If you can do that by EOD tomorrow we'll finalize the kickoff invite.

If Wed 2–4 PM PT works for you we can send the invite; otherwise Thu AM is fine.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, ISV Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 02 Feb 2027 15:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Partnership proposal — LangChain + LlamaIndex adapter + tracing hooks

Marissa / Mateo — great, we appreciate the clear ownership split.

Answers inline and next steps:
- LangChain connectors: we'll exercise OpenAIWrapper, AnthropicWrapper (for internal regression), and a custom REST wrapper. LlamaIndex flow will be read-only retrieval for the pilot; document ingestion is scoped for a later phase.
- Tracing: we need token-level spans for all calls for the first two weeks to validate correlation; after that we can move to 10% sampling.
- Sandbox data: confirmed — non-PII only. We'll mark test prompts accordingly.

We've completed the sandbox entitlements tab in the MAM and uploaded an integration checklist to the Drive. I've scheduled the kickoff for Wed 02/03 2:30–3:30 PM PT and sent a calendar invite to the attendees listed. If you prefer a longer block we can extend to 2–4 PM as discussed.

Looking forward to kickoff — Jordan
Jordan Halpern
Head of Integrations, PromptWorks
jordan@promptworks.ai
